evidence_guardrail: Structured abstract avoids causal and clinical-deployment claims.
Keywords emphasize method and biology, not clinical deployment.
Introduction states rationale without overclaiming prior causal evidence.
Results retain candidate and heterogeneity language.
Discussion explicitly states not causal and not a validated mechanism.
Methods distinguish completed analysis from planned validation.
Supplementary table naming still needs journal formatting.
Local scripts are ready, but repository/DOI language remains manual.
Author contributions, conflicts, funding, and ethics text require user input.
